LESSON: ADDITION

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade two
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Numbers
Topic 1.3: Addition
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 20

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Addition, part of Numbers in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade two MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How are horizontal addition sentences written vertically? 2. Why do we regroup during addition?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. Write mount/ type/ stamp addition sentences given in horizontal form into vertical form according to place value, using any alternative functional part of the body and/ appropriate Assistive technology/device with physical support to carry out the activity. Those who may not perform the task could alternatively arrange number cards or mention their responses orally as they are audio-visually recorded and the recorded clip saved in their e-portfolio as evidence of performing the task. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. Write mount/ type/ stamp addition sentences given in horizontal form into vertical form according to place value, using any alternative functional part of the body and/ appropriate Assistive technology/device with physical support to carry out the activity. Those who may not perform the task could alternatively arrange number cards or mention their responses orally as they are audio-visually recorded and the recorded clip saved in their e-portfolio as evidence of performing the task. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Addition together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: learner speaks and listens to peers as they discuss different ways of adding two 2-digit

numbers without and with regrouping.

• Learning to learn: learner discovers ways of presenting addition as they write addition statements in horizontal and vertical

forms.

Values:
● Social justice: learner accommodates others as they play games involving addition.

● Unity: learner discusses and comes up with different ways of adding two 2-digit numbers without and with regrouping.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Critical thinking: learner works out missing numbers in patterns involving addition.

● Friendship formation: learner plays games involving addition with peers.

Link to other learning areas:

● The learner relates the skills used in making patterns to the concept of patterns in Creative Activities.

● The learner relates the skills used in writing addition sentences in horizontal and vertical forms to functional writing in

English Language Activities.
